sections.title: Round 22 Tips
sections.heading: Recommended card for Prince_of_Penrith
lines: Cowboys v Roosters - Roosters. Sportsbet has Sydney $1.53; the Roosters are second and the better ladder-protect pick despite missing Tupou, Billy Smith and Lindsay Collins.
Dragons v Dolphins - Dolphins. Sportsbet has the Dolphins $1.24; Dragons remain stuck on two wins and the Dolphins come off the bye with Jack Bostock, Jake Averillo and Ray Stone named to return.
Storm v Bulldogs - Bulldogs. Sportsbet has Canterbury $1.52; Melbourne lose Harry Grant and Jack Howarth, while Canterbury keep the same starting 13 that beat the Warriors.
Titans v Warriors - Titans. Sportsbet has Warriors $1.57 and Titans $2.42; TipBot takes the one controlled split after Gold Coast's 38-18 win and Warriors fullback Taine Tuaupiki being out.
Panthers v Raiders - Panthers. Sportsbet has Penrith $1.35; Dylan Edwards remains out but Jack Cogger returns and Penrith still have Cleary, Martin and Yeo.
Broncos v Knights - Broncos. Sportsbet has Brisbane $1.50; Newcastle get Ponga and Gagai back but lose Dylan Brown and Dylan Lucas for the season.
Sharks v Rabbitohs - Sharks. Sportsbet has Cronulla $1.27; the Sharks are in strong attacking form and get Tom Hazelton back.
Wests Tigers v Eels - Eels. Sportsbet has Parramatta $1.41; Tigers are still unsettled while the Eels get Junior Paulo back via the bench.

sections.title: Late Mail
sections.heading: Selection notes driving the card
lines: Cowboys: Reed Mahoney enters concussion protocols and Griffin Neame is suspended; Soni Luke starts at hooker and Tom Mikaele starts in the front row.
Roosters: Tommy Talau replaces Daniel Tupou, Hugo Savala replaces Billy Smith and Lindsay Collins remains sidelined by concussion concerns.
Dolphins: Jack Bostock, Jake Averillo and Ray Stone are named to return; Isaiya Katoa is listed in the reserves.
Storm: Harry Grant is out with a hamstring injury and Jack Howarth is out after a training shoulder injury.
Bulldogs: Canterbury keep the same starting 13 that beat the Warriors, with Kurt Mann back on the bench.
Warriors: Charnze Nicoll-Klokstad replaces injured Taine Tuaupiki at fullback.
Panthers: Dylan Edwards remains sidelined; Jack Cogger replaces Blaize Talagi at five-eighth.
Knights: Kalyn Ponga and Dane Gagai return, but Dylan Brown and Dylan Lucas are gone for the season.
Eels: Junior Paulo is named to return from a knee injury via the bench.
